title: Shade trees for uncovered at-grade car parking: one small tree per four spaces
text: C1.2.5 Uncovered at-grade car parking to include shade trees planted at a minimum ratio of one small tree for every four car spaces, with the total number of trees to be rounded up to the nearest whole number. Note: These trees are in addition to the trees to be provided in accordance with C1.2.4.

replaces.note: C2.1(iii) one tree per four uncovered spaces
landscaping with shade trees between every six consecutive external spaces

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Ratio (1 per 4 spaces, rounded up) checks on p12. Table 2.10a (p26) says 'no minimum tree provisions' for R100-SL against C1.2.1, C1.2.2 and C1.2.4 only; whether that also removes the C1.2.5 shade trees is not stated, so coding stays all.

notes: diverges: a different provision under the same number. Chapter 3 C1.2.5 (p12) is shade trees for at-grade parking; Chapter 2 C1.2.5 is the retained-tree root zone, which is C1.2.7 here. Applies where uncovered at-grade spaces are provided (rule condition). trees >= ceil(spaces / 4) is tested as 4 x trees >= spaces (equivalent for whole numbers). Trees are additional to C1.2.4 trees (not netted out). Proposed facts parking.uncovered_at_grade_spaces and landscape.parking_shade_trees replace the boolean parking.shade_trees_per_4_bays. Table 2.10a 'no minimum tree provisions' for R100-SL is tied to C1.2.4; whether it also removes C1.2.5 is unclear, so coding is all.
